messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — planning a small UI deploy at 17:30 UTC today for the privacy banner change (non-blocking). Aiming for a staggered canary -> full rollout.

Josh Li: 👍 What % for the canary?

Maya Patel: Start at 5% for 10 min, then 25% for 15 min, then 100% if smoke is clean.

Arjun Gupta: I'll run the CDN invalidation after canary reaches 25%. We'll do targeted paths for the banner assets only. Command I'll run:
```bash
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E3EXAMPLE --paths "/assets/privacy-banner*"
```

Samira Khan: QA checklist for smoke: banner shows on fresh session, dismiss persists, event `privacy_banner_shown` fires, and no JS errors in console. I'll test mobile and desktop.

Josh Li: Deployment plan notes:
- Build tag: `ui-release/2026-03-17-privacy-banner`
- Canary routing by cookie `ui-canary` (handled by router)
- Rollback: `revert-to ui-release/previous` via deploy pipeline (two-step approval from Arjun or Maya)

Maya Patel: Also toggling cache-control TTL on the banner asset to 60s for the rollout window to reduce edge staleness. After full rollout we'll set it back to 24h.

Arjun Gupta: One more thing — we'll avoid full `/*` invalidation to keep costs down. Targeted invalidation + short TTL should be enough. I'll post the invalidation ID here when done.

DeployBot: [deploy-pipeline] build started for ui-release/2026-03-17-privacy-banner (build #412)

QA-Bot: New smoke checklist created: `PRIV-BANNER-2026-03-17`. Assigned to Samira.

Samira Khan: On it. I'll ping here with pass/fail at each hop.

Maya Patel: Who's monitoring metrics? I'd like someone to watch frontend error rate + console logs and the banner telemetry for the next 30m post-100% rollout.

Josh Li: I'll monitor Sentry and infra dashboards. Arjun, can you watch edge error stats?

Arjun Gupta: Yes. I'll watch edge 5xxs and CDN latency for 30m.

Samira Khan: Canary 5% -> checking now: banner appears, dismiss persists, event recorded. No console errors so far.

Maya Patel: Good. Move to 25% in 2 mins.

Samira Khan: 25% smoke pass: mobile flows OK, desktop OK.

Arjun Gupta: Running targeted invalidation now. Invalidation ID: I2KEXAMPLE12345.

DeployBot: [deploy-pipeline] canary promoted to 25% (build #412)

Josh Li: All right. If 15-min hang at 25% is clean we promote to 100%. Reminder: approval required to promote — Maya or Arjun, please approve in the pipeline when ready.

Maya Patel: Approved. Promote when QA gives final thumbs.

Samira Khan: 25% hold complete. No regressions observed. Approving full rollout.

DeployBot: [deploy-pipeline] promotion approved by Maya Patel

DeployBot: [deploy-pipeline] rolling out to 100% (build #412)

Arjun Gupta: After 100% completes I'll set TTL back to 24h and remove the targeted invalidation rules.

Samira Khan: Full rollout smoke: banner appears for fresh sessions, dismiss persists across refresh, telemetry spikes look expected. No JS errors.

Josh Li: Monitoring green. No elevated errors.

Maya Patel: Great — thanks everyone. Post-mortem: none needed for a routine rollout. Small follow-up: add a quick runbook note about targeted invalidations and TTL bump for future banner-ish UX changes.

Arjun Gupta: Noted — I'll add a short entry to the release playbook.

Samira Khan: Closing checklist and archiving `PRIV-BANNER-2026-03-17`.

DeployBot: [deploy-pipeline] release complete — ui-release/2026-03-17-privacy-banner (build #412)

Maya Patel: If anyone sees late regressions in the next 24h ping #incidents and @eng-oncall. Otherwise closing thread. :tada:
